label: XDCR Advanced Filtering
type: the mechanism restricting which documents an XDCR replication carries from source to target, evaluated via an xdcr:filtering-expression using xdcr:regular-expression syntax and xdcr:collation-comparison semantics. Cannot be performed on documents that are a bare JSON array with no enclosing object.
evidence: Full, Cluster, and XDCR Administrators can configure XDCR filtering.
It cannot be performed on documents that contain only a JSON array — with the elements surrounded only by square brackets.
If your operational cluster is on Couchbase Server version 7.2.2 or later, choose whether to Filter Binary Documents.
note: Capella's manage-xdcr-replications.md names a 'Filter Binary Documents' checkbox gated on Server 7.2.2+; none of this batch's five Server filtering-reference pages mention binary-document filtering or that version gate - a one-way documentation asymmetry recorded rather than resolved (see docs-issues).
relates_to_competency_question: Can an XDCR replication be restricted to a subset of documents, and are there document shapes that restriction can never reach?
